name: Mushrooms, white (button), boiled
note: USDA SR26 11261 (Mushrooms, white, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt). Cooked weight. Plain only - no butter, oil, salt, garlic or onion. Shop-bought culinary mushrooms only; never wild-picked. Higher in potassium and phosphorus than most vegetables - keep portions small in CKD. Oxalate: OHF 2024.

name: Mushrooms, chestnut (crimini), raw weight
note: USDA SR26 11266 (Mushrooms, brown, italian, or crimini, raw). Weigh raw, then cook. Plain only - no butter, oil, salt, garlic or onion. Shop-bought culinary mushrooms only; never wild-picked. Higher in potassium and phosphorus than most vegetables - keep portions small in CKD. Filled from AFCD R3 F005946 (Mushroom, common, fresh, raw), scaled x1.14 for water content: i. Oxalate: OHF 2024.

name: Mushrooms, portobello, grilled
note: USDA SR26 11243 (Mushrooms, portabella, grilled). Cooked weight, not UV-treated (UV 'vitamin D' mushrooms are much higher in vitamin D). Plain only - no butter, oil, salt, garlic or onion. Shop-bought culinary mushrooms only; never wild-picked. Higher in potassium and phosphorus than most vegetables - keep portions small in CKD. Oxalate: OHF 2024.

name: Mushrooms, shiitake, cooked
note: USDA SR26 11269 (Mushrooms, shiitake, cooked, without salt). Cooked weight; always cook shiitake (raw can cause skin rash). Plain only - no butter, oil, salt, garlic or onion. Shop-bought culinary mushrooms only; never wild-picked. Higher in potassium and phosphorus than most vegetables - keep portions small in CKD. Oxalate: OHF 2024.

name: Mushrooms, oyster, raw weight
note: USDA SR26 11987 (Mushrooms, oyster, raw). Weigh raw, then cook. Plain only - no butter, oil, salt, garlic or onion. Shop-bought culinary mushrooms only; never wild-picked. Higher in potassium and phosphorus than most vegetables - keep portions small in CKD. Oxalate: OHF 2024.
